scope: Exact LGPL/MPL native library sources and build recipes; a conservative superset of permissive dependency sources and notice terms, including test/build crates that may not be linked. Canvas Rust versions retained from official release CI30338026389; librsvg Rust sources from the release Cargo.lock files. Windows imagequant is the BSD2 lovell fork; its supplementary POSIX archive is not claimed to reproduce Windows objects.
